consequence.statement: The `flux migrate` command becomes available in the flux CLI as a new capability; the evidence states nothing that fails, changes, or must be run, so an operator who does nothing sees no operational difference.

assertion.statement: Flux 2.7.0 adds a new `flux migrate` CLI command.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The evidence only announces that the `flux migrate` command was implemented; it states no configuration, resource, image, or version condition that determines which environments it affects.
